lines.t: I keep circling the places Where I thought I lost your face
Replaying every failure Like it still defines my name
But you don't stop and stare You don't linger in my past
You look at me completed like exchanges finished fast
How is my past relevant when you see me like you do
Every other voice grows silent in the light of knowing you
You see me whole, you call me yours
You don't replay, I was before
If you see me this way, what else could I do?
I'd give you my life, it's the least I can do
I thought you kept a record, I was braced for what you'd say
But you were busy calling me by a future I'd not claimed
You aren't saving any files of who I've always been
You override all that accuses to install your life within
You perceive me in glory, not in the dirt that is here
How could shame survive? Love makes it disappear
You see me whole, you call me yours
You don't replay what I was before
If you see me this way, what else could I do?
I give you my life, it's the least I can do
If you've washed every stain, why do I keep holding on?
If you've already called me clean, I won't bind to what is gone
Teach my heart to rest where your eyes have always been
Not who I was, but who I am
And you
And you
You see me, oh, oh
You call me yours
No accusations
Use any more
If you see me this way
I'm finally free
I'll give you my soul, and thankfully, it's enough
It's enough
It's enough
It's enough
You see me
As I will be, so I'll learn to see myself that way too
